---
name: Problem report
about: The stick did not do what you expected
---

**Mazda Connect version and region**
(from the `diag-*.txt` file: `JCI_SW_VER`, `JCI_SW_VER_PATCH`, `JCI_SW_FLAVOR`)

**Car model and year**

**What you did and what happened**
(which button, which message on the screen)

**Files** (drag them here)
- `mzd-usb.log` from the stick
- the newest `diag-*.txt` from the stick (press "Diagnosis" if there is none)
- `touchtune/touchtune.log` if it exists

Please do NOT attach the `backup-aa-touch-*` folders: they contain the
original configuration files of your car.

Problems with Android Auto touch itself belong to
https://github.com/VitaliyKurokhtin/oem-aa-mod, problems with touch while
driving to https://github.com/Miatafy/TouchTune — but please report here
first if you used this stick.
